Albuquerque property tax is billed by the offices named below.

Who bills what in Albuquerque

  • Bernalillo County Assessor handles assessment.
  • Bernalillo County Treasurer bills and collects the tax.

Due dates

Bills mailed Nov 1; first half due Nov 10, late fees begin Dec 10; second half due Apr 10, late fees begin May 10 (Treasurer page).. See the official page.

Challenging your assessment

Notices of Value mailed ~Apr 1; 30-day protest window (2026 NOV mailed Apr 1, deadline May 1 per county news; BPP/manufactured home/livestock deadline June 1; amended NOV protests 30 days from amended mail date). File online via Appeal Portal or at 415 Silver Ave SW.. See the official page.

Tax rate

We could not confirm the current Albuquerque rate on an opened page, so we do not state one.

Local notes

  • New Mexico: the elected County Assessor values property; the elected County Treasurer bills and collects for the county, city, schools and state. Cities do not assess or collect property tax separately.
  • Census Vintage 2025 population 556588; county Bernalillo County.
  • Albuquerque is in Bernalillo County (Census SUMLEV 157 shows only Bernalillo part).
Behind on Albuquerque property tax?

Get My Cash Offer →

Albuquerque by the numbers

The Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey counts about 562,488 people in Albuquerque, which makes it the 1st largest of the 11 nm places we cover. The median value of an owner-occupied home is $266,700, 30% above the median of those 11 places. 62% of occupied homes are owner-occupied and 38% are rented, against a median of 63% owner-occupancy across the nm places. The median home was built in 1982, about 41 years ago, which matters for roofs, plumbing and inspection requests. These numbers describe Albuquerque as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.

Challenging your assessment

Protest petition filed with County Assessor within 30 days of official NOV mail date; appraiser site review, informal conference, then formal hearing before the County Valuation Protest Board.. See the official page.

Santa Fe by the numbers

Santa Fe has roughly 88,224 residents in the Census Bureau's 2019-2023 survey, and ranks number 4 by population among the 11 nm places in this guide. Owner-occupied homes have a median value of $411,500 here, which is 101% above the middle figure for the 11 nm places. About 37% of households rent, so 63% own; the nm median for these places is 63% owner-occupied. Homes here were typically built in 1985, so the median house is about 38 years old.
